health_life_timing.rule: Accepted fatal damage commits health=0, lives=max(lives-1,0), HealthBar.dead=1 immediately, before optional knockback. Later hits return lethal without charging another life.

state5_repeat_hit.rule: When invulnerability expires while state5, a new accepted hit copies the impulse, rewrites impulse.z=4 and updates health/pending, but does not re-enter damage or reset velocity/height/phase. Future turn uses new impulse.

nonlethal_no_horizontal.rule: No XY impulse OR crawl: health and invulnerability still update, but surviving hit does not enter damage and existing state/motion remains.

force_hit.rule: damage>=1000 immediately enters state6 except when already state6; copies graph and sound sequence; bypasses pending/invulnerability gates; this branch does not set the600-tick timer.

surface_damage_gate.rule: Ground-surface damage requires floor equality and is skipped for pending, state6, or nonzero invulnerability even when ground damage is large.

damage_payload_vector.rule: vector = target.position - sender.actor_0x68; force sourceZ=0; zero vector becomes(0,0,1); normalize; multiply by state+0x1C. Nonzero XY thus yields awayXY*multiplier; Hugo damage-entry then produces awayXY*multiplier*9 Godot units/s.

state_update_order.rule: Main handler dispatches pre1E079, re-reads current state, then dispatches step1E07A. Landing transition prevents another damage integration in that update.

death_lifetime.rule: Entry uses primary action13 if graph null, otherwise replacement graph state0 duration. Death tick observes finished animation and sends22000011 to HealthBar, which sets death-sequence-ready flag. Pending itself remains until reset.

contact_sound.rule: Force branch anchors retained CSoundSequence at current player position. Custom death entry resets sequence; death update samples it using death ticker phase. Actor contact does not independently trigger this sequence.

modern_save_adapter.rule: Resume a pending fatal arc even when remaining lives=0; do not charge a second life at landing/death playback. Historical v2 ordinary death saves can keep their documented checkpoint recovery.
modern_save_adapter.unresolved: Legacy suspended saves of this in-flight state were not demonstrated; this is a modern persistence policy preserving proven live-state invariants.

contact_solver_adapter.godot_approximation: Actual Godot floor/contact state and nonpositive source-equivalent upward velocity; do not substitute an invented timeout.

normal_input_gameplay.scope: Eight standalone source chapter starts were explored. Final evidence covers two first checkpoints, a real moving-platform contact/carry, and one native 4K frame from the frozen exported pack. No full chapter or campaign playthrough is claimed.

startup_configuration.explanation: The standalone route harness initializes a three-life budget (one fewer than a fresh production campaign). moving_platform_detail.visual_limit: The authored rail camera is occluded by the mechanism housing during this optional piston-platform ride. These frames are retained as raw evidence, not selected presentation images. No camera or scenery was changed to hide this.

failed_stale_record_replay.claim: Not a successful pass; retained without erasure. A pre-freeze input recording diverged on the frozen damage code and died at tick309. A new frozen recording then reached the checkpoint and replayed exactly.

navigation_limits: A camera rail is not a navigation mesh; the greedy baseline routes can cut across holes or target boxes higher than the native jump. Their deaths/blocks are not by themselves controller defects.
The first Mines crate was bypassed through source-supported floor; the successful checkpoint route intentionally skips diamonds. A separate exploratory route collected six before death.

The Meltdown route uses the original side stairs, legal consecutive grounded jumps and actual platform contacts. An artificial 70-tick pause between jumps in the old diagnostic policy was removed from the harness, not the game.
Moving-platform screenshots are occluded by the source mechanism housing; the two checkpoint screenshots are the approved presentation images.
None of these runs reaches a chapter exit. They do not establish that all eight chapters can be completed by a human.
